_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for sg13cmos5l-startup-trip-point on the `klt sim` harness (issue #337, Part of #322).
The per-experiment half of the adapter contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file. Narrative is carried over from the legacy run_pvt_sweep.sh record text; it is not a new claim.
Infrastructure/plumbing evidence for issue #65's port, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row (spec/ tracks no ratified SG13CMOS5L accuracy target).
Claim: sg13g2-bandgap's SG13CMOS5L bandgap_startup circuit (design/sg13cmos5l/bandgap_startup.sch, issue #68) engages at cold start (core sense node at 0 V => det pulled to >= 80% of vdd, fb held below 100 mV, i.e. the PMOS mirror is forced on) and disengages once the core is running (core sense node near vdd => det below 20% of vdd and fb released above 80% of vdd), with a well-defined trip point strictly inside (0, vdd), across the full temperature x supply x MOS/resistor-process-corner grid. The six-criteria verdict is applied per point by sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py (same formula as sim/lib/pvt_verdict_common.sh pvt_trip_point_verdict). Infrastructure/plumbing evidence, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row.
Devices: All real PDK compact models -- sg13_hv_nmos (PSP103.6 via psp103.osdi) x2 and rhigh (r3_cmc via r3_cmc.osdi).
Netlist provenance: design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/bandgap_startup.spice, device-for-device, plus the sns1 stimulus source and the 10 Mohm fb pull-up fixture documented in testbench/ and README.md.
PDK: `ihp-sg13cmos5l` -- the TARGET/SETUP pin in sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json (IHP-Open-PDK dev subtree, sibling `ihp-sg13g2/` required). No record has yet been generated on that pin, so runtime compatibility is UNVERIFIED until the first one exists; a record minted from this spec must be read against the pin its run actually resolved (report `environment`), not against this sentence. OSDI models: sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json "osdi_toolchain".
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} (MOS-hv x resistor sections; this bench instantiates no bipolar) x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points)
